planes.leyendaBeta: BETA mode until 31-12-2026. Trying the site does not activate a plan. To become a member: SIGN UP and ACTIVATE by that date.
planes.frasePago: PLUS, PRO or ÉLITE PLANS are paid in full when you ACTIVATE the one you chose, no later than 31 December 2026. From 1 January 2027 payment is due in full at the moment of ACTIVATION. Creating an account in SIGN UP with a user type does not mean taking a PLAN. INICIANTE is not a plan: it is paid at SIGN UP. Installments on an international card are set by your bank, not by drones.orientese.com.
planes.pagoExtra: In BETA (October to December 2026) you may sign up and use the plan before invoicing is live. When you ACTIVATE (deadline 31-12-2026 UTC) you pay the full amount. Invoice by email when the LLC is operating. The site does not split installments.
planes.cambioTexto: If you switch plans mid-year after paying, the difference is charged in favor of drones.orientese.com or offset with extra simulator uses and extra JOBS or USED listings. No refunds. At renewal (end of the 365 days) you choose any plan and pay only that plan. INICIANTE is not renewed back-to-back: when it ends you become a Visitor and may return to INICIANTE only one year later, unless you move to PLUS, PRO or ÉLITE.
planes.panelIntro: This is not a plan. Until 31-12-2026 you may use the site with low quotas. Payment submit is off. To become a member: SIGN UP and ACTIVATE by that date.
planes.panelCupoSim: Simulator: up to 3 uses per day.
planes.panelCupoVagas: JOBS: 1 listing per day, max 6 in the whole BETA. Expires 31-12-2026. Genuine listings only.
planes.panelCupoUsados: USED: 1 listing per day, max 6 in the whole BETA. Expires 31-12-2026. Real gear only.
planes.panelCupoAds: ADVERTISERS / SPONSORS: 1 piece per day, max 3 in BETA. Visible 2 days or until 31-12-2026.

sim.d: Try the simulator (3 uses per day).

vagas.d: View and post a staff request (BETA quota).

usados.d: View and post gear listings (BETA quota).

anunciantes.d: View the showcase and the BETA ad quota.

registro.d: Choose a plan and become a member.
